title: The Requirement of Discipleship
description: Jesus turns to the crowds following him and says that whoever wants to be his disciple must put him above family and their own life, and carry their cross. He uses two parables – one about a man who wants to build a tower and another about a king who goes to war – to show that one must calculate the cost. Finally, he says that no one can be his disciple without giving up everything they have.
